Chicken with garlic butter sauce

Serves 4

Savoury crust

  • 2 large chicken breasts, 200–250 g each (Note 1)
  • 2 tbsp plain flour

Butter sauce

  • 20 g unsalted butter
  • 2 garlic cloves, minced
  • 60 ml dry white wine (Note 2)

Full method

  1. Pound the chicken breasts to an even thickness. Season and coat in flour.
  2. Melt half the butter in a frying pan over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 3 minutes, turn and cook for 4 minutes, until cooked through. Transfer to a plate.
  3. Add the remaining butter and garlic to the pan. Stir in the wine and simmer for 2 minutes.
  4. Serve the chicken with the butter sauce.

Notes

1. Chicken – use evenly sized breasts.

2. Wine – use a dry white wine.
